steps.npc: Gnome Air is the finest airline in Gielinor!
Well...it's the only real airline in Gielinor.

steps.player: What do you mean by real airline?

steps.npc: Well there's a dodgy magic carpet operation in the desert, I doubt it will ever take off... Ha!
Glough has ordered that I only take gnomes on Gnome Air.

options.text: How much for one-way to Varrock?

steps.player: How much for one-way to Varrock?

steps.npc: I would, but Glough has told me not to take humans on Gnome Air.

options.text: Can you take me on the glider?

steps.player: Can you take me on the glider?

options.text: Why are gliders better than other transport?

steps.player: Why are gliders better than other transport?

steps.npc: Oh we have a whole network! It's wonderful for getting to hard to reach places.
There are so many places where your teleports cannot reach!

steps.player: How did you all manage to build such an established network?

steps.npc: I think you'll find that is a gnome trade secret!

options.text: Sorry, I don't want anything now.

steps.player: Sorry, I don't want anything now.

standard-dialogue-karamja.npc: I don't think I can fix this. Looks like I'll be heading back by foot.

standard-dialogue-east-of-varrock.npc: A bit of a technical hitch with the landing gear. I won't be able to fly you anywhere, sorry.

gnome-restaurant.text: If the player doesn't have the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!

gnome-restaurant.text: If the player has a premade item in their inventory:

steps.text: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.

gnome-restaurant.text: If the player has the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Captain Errdo
If the player does have a reward token available:
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
If the player has an unclaimed reward token:
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
If the player has claimed their reward token:

gnome-restaurant.text: If the player ran out of time:

steps.text: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
